status: SOURCE IMPLEMENTED / RUNTIME NOT YET VERIFIED
implemented: First close request remains fail-closed and initiates cooperative shutdown.
Registry timeout no longer requires a second manual close request.
A 250 ms QTimer polls registry snapshots without QThread.wait() or terminate().
Each polling tick emits measurement_ms, budget_ms=25 and budget_exceeded.
When survivor_count reaches zero, the application automatically resumes final close processing.
Single-flight state prevents duplicate polling timers and repeated pre-registry shutdown work.
Non-modal closing progress dialog can be hidden.
not_implemented: A true Cancel Shutdown action is intentionally not included because the existing shutdown path already performs irreversible service/thread stops before registry waiting. Offering Cancel would falsely imply safe restoration of RUNNING state.
